red__fitscube_mask.pro

includes main-level program

Routines

top source red::fitscube_mask

SST pipeline

red::fitscube_mask, infile [, ituning=integer] [, /noflip], /no_qhull, /include_I, /no_crop, no_wb_mask=no_wb_mask, mask=array, nomissing_nans=nomissing_nans, /overwrite, tag=string

Define and apply a mask on the FOV of a fitscube and then crop to fit.

Parameters

infile in type=string

The path to the input fitscube.

Keywords

ituning in optional type=integer

The tuning index of the Stokes image displayed when defining the mask. If not given, the core tuning will be used.

noflip in optional type=boolean

If set, don't make any spectral, "flipped" data cubes.

no_qhull in type=boolean

Instead of computing the mask from the convex hull of several ROIs, just use the union of the ROIs.

include_I in type=boolean

If set, use mask also for stokes I and crop NB and WB cubes.

no_crop in type=boolean

If set, don't crop the FOV.

no_wb_mask
mask in out type=array

FOV mask to be reused with other cubes (particularly WB cube).

nomissing_nans
overwrite in type=boolean

Overwrite an existing file.

tag in type=string default=masked

If not overwriting the original file, add this tag to the original filename.
